messages:
mia: Heads-up — getting asked to confirm GPU quota & creds handoff for the new EU rack. Any update on vendor ETA and whether we can escalate quota increase? Need to unblock dedicated pool for demo next week.
sanjay: Vendor (JP) said racks shipped, ETA customs 3/21. Still waiting final rack serials. I requested an invoice + manifest this morning. @vendor-jp any chance to push serials.csv?
vendor-jp: Sending manifest now. Putting serials in S3: s3://redwood-procure/manifests/17178-rack-eu.csv. ETA customs 48-72h. Will DM credentials for SSH jumpbox after manifest is validated.
taylor: For quota increase, send cloud support ticket with tenant id + expected sustained v100 hours. I can attach cost approval. Example command to check current quota: ```aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --region eu-west-1```
olivia: FYI finance needs PO before we release reserved capacity. @taylor can you add estimated month cost? we'll fast-track PO.
sanjay: Also, can oncall rotate to validate firmware image once we have rack serials? Prefer night window Wed->Thu. @alex extra hands for smoke test.
alex: I can standby Wed 00:00-04:00 UTC. Ping me when serials + jumpbox creds are in the ops channel.
devops-bot: New support ticket created #123456 for quota request, assigned to taylor.
taylor: Filed the support ticket and attached cost estimate. Linking ticket: https://cloud.support/tickets/123456. Finance, estimate is ~$18k/mo for reserved A100 pool (pre-negotiation).
vendor-jp: Manifest uploaded and emailed customs declaration. Will share serials and jumpbox creds by EOD. Apologies for the slow handoff.
mia: Great — timeline OK for demo? If customs confirms in 72h and we have creds Wed morning, we can smoke Wed night and open pool Thu morning. @olivia does that align with PO SLA?
olivia: We'll try to get PO signed Thu morning. If vendor needs earlier partial release, we can approve provisional access for limited tests.
sanjay: One last note — once serials arrive, run this short check on jumpbox: `ssh ops@jumpbox && sudo cat /etc/rack-serials | grep A100`. If mismatch, DM vendor immediately.
mia: Thanks all. I'll update the demo runbook and move the canary to Thu morning. Will post confirmations here as they come. :thumbsup:
